definitions.explanation: A large-scale sports competition or athletic event.
A large gathering of people for a specific purpose, such as a conference or assembly.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}、テニスの{大会|たいかい}に{出|で}る。
examples.english: I'm participating in a tennis tournament next month.

examples.japanese: オリンピック{大会|たいかい}は4{年|ねん}に1{度|ど}{開|ひら}かれる。
examples.english: The Olympic Games are held once every four years.

examples.japanese: {党|とう}の{大会|たいかい}で{新|あたら}しい{方針|ほうしん}が{発表|はっぴょう}された。
examples.english: A new policy was announced at the party convention.

notes:
COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {運動会|うんどうかい} (sports day, athletic meet)
- {世界大会|せかいたいかい} (world championship)
- {全国大会|ぜんこくたいかい} (national tournament)
- {決勝大会|けっしょうたいかい} (finals, championship game)

COLLOCATIONS:
- {大会|たいかい}に{出|で}る / {出場|しゅつじょう}する (to participate in a tournament)
- {大会|たいかい}を{開|ひら}く / {開催|かいさい}する (to hold a tournament)
- {大会|たいかい}で{優勝|ゆうしょう}する (to win a tournament)
